description: Scaleway's OpenAPI export drops query parameters that belong to a proto `oneOf`, so `ListJobs` lose filters the API takes. The official JS SDK sends them through `resolveOneOf` in `urlParams` — scaleway-sdk-js packages_generated/qaas/src/v1alpha1/api.gen.ts — with the types in the sibling types.gen.ts. They are added as optional query members; the API enforces the one-of. Live on 2026-10-12, a call with only `project_id` answered `invalid_arguments` "session_id must be provided", so in practice `session_id` is the one the API accepts.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: List jobs of this session. One-of `resource_id` with `session_id` / `project_id`; the API requires `session_id` in practice (a call with only `project_id` is rejected).
